text:
maya: Heads up — runtime sticky-hold still at 100% for quantized models in eu-west. Seeing gradual warmup but tail latency not stable yet.
sam: what telemetry are we tracking for the exit decision? I thought QA would give a thumbs after 24h stable p50/p95
maya: QA asked for two things: no p95 regressions >15% vs baseline, and error-rate <0.5% for longseq jobs (>=2048). We had one spike overnight on a single host.
lee: spike traced to a kernel fallback on g4dn-16x. Patch landed yesterday but only rolled to canary 5%.
nana: @maya can you paste the deploybot pinlist diff? need to update release notes and changelog if we lift hold.
maya: sure — deploybot output:
```
deploybot: pinlist update
- runtime: runtime-v3.2 -> STICKY_HOLD
- region: eu-west (100%)
- reason: kv-cache longseq regressions
- canary: runtime-v3.2-canary@5% (patched)
```
sam: For off-ramp propose: 24h stable telemetry, 12h smoke on canary 25%, update release notes, and rollback if p95 >10% or error-rate >0.75%.
lee: canary timeline: 0h->5% (done), +6h->25%, +18h->50%, +36h->100% if green. Ops will monitor.
ops_oncall: I'll take night watch. Add me to canary-alerts channel. Set thresholds for p95 and tx-error.
zach: also pin SDK compat note — SDKs <=2.7 may see token drift with runtime-v3.2; recommend SDK>=2.8.
maya: filing release note one-liner and internal SE note.
nana: who owns customer comms? Dedicated customers saw slight latency increases.
sam: support lead olga to draft proactive heads-up for Dedicated customers in affected regions. CC account execs.
lee: runbook: rollback command `deploybot rollback runtime-v3.1 -> runtime-v3.0` (automated traffic drain, 5m grace). Test before 50% rollout.
ops_oncall: testing rollback in staging now; will confirm in ~30m.
maya: action items: 1) nana draft customer heads-up, 2) zach update SDK note + PR, 3) ops_oncall watch alerts overnight, 4) lee coordinate canary ->25% in 6h, 5) sam draft exit criteria doc.
sam: add abort condition: >3 hosts with p95 regression => abort and pin back.
zach: pushed SDK PR https://git.internal/r/sdk/compat/PR-142
ops_oncall: staging rollback tested — clean. rollback latency back to baseline in 2m.
maya: re-evaluate at 6h checkpoint. If green, schedule unpin +8h to give SEs time to prep docs. :thumbsup:
deploybot: noted. Manual unpin when authorized: `deploybot unpin runtime-v3.2 --region eu-west --note "off-ramp criteria met"`.
lee: telemetry filter: exclude warmup-only jobs (<10 queries) to avoid noise.
sam: updating monitoring dashboard and alert runbooks now.
nana: customer draft sent to olga for review, added mitigations.
maya: thanks team. reconvene after 6h checkpoint.
